verdict.rationale: Otter's pricing page lists "Otter API & Webhooks" as a plan feature, so the product itself claims webhooks. However, the only Public API documentation describes retrieval endpoints and never mentions webhook registration, event types, or payloads, so the evidence amounts to a single thin mention. Missing for 10: documented webhook registration/subscription mechanism, list of subscribable events, payload/delivery/retry semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
